summary: The implementation satisfies the saved Python/Alembic migration-chain validation plan. It includes non-mutating graph inspection with structured reason codes for multiple heads, missing down revisions, duplicate revision ids, branch-label anomalies, and clean single-head chains; reuses the inspector from the target-branch resolver without adding an auto-fix flow; adds opt-in profile policy fields, identity inputs, runtime policy execution, durable logs/artifacts, executor validation provenance, and Aira-only built-in enablement. Focused tests, ruff, mypy, the full unit suite, and the full coverage gate all passed; coverage reached 99.06% against the 99% requirement.
